proves.claim: Different config defaults compose by disjoint key in either order, retaining comments and nested values; deletion, existing-key edits and divergent additions remain conflicts.

merge.io-defaults-compose.disjoint-and-s.why: A defaults conflict policy must preserve both independent settings while refusing edits it cannot safely combine.

proves.claim: Deleting a config default while another branch edits it remains a conflict in both merge orders.

merge.io-defaults-compose.delete-versus-.why: A concurrent deletion must not silently erase or restore a changed default.

proves.claim: disjoint test-tier rows compose as the exact alphabetical union in both directions.

merge.io-test-tiers-compose.disjoint-bot.why: A tier manifest composition must preserve every row field and produce identical bytes independent of input order.

proves.claim: conflicting edits to a shared test-tier key name the key in both directions and do not run work.

merge.io-test-tiers-compose.same-row-ref.why: Two contributors must not silently replace one another's tier row.

proves.claim: the cells and path row schemas compose as exact sorted unions with identical bytes in both directions.

merge.io-plan-index-compose.disjoint-bot.why: Plan index rows need deterministic composition at the exact merge head.

proves.claim: conflicting edits to shared cell and path keys name both keys in both directions and do not run work.

merge.io-plan-index-compose.same-row-ref.why: A plan composition must refuse two contributors editing the same named row.
